lead: Choir study videos, voice by voice (Soprano, Alto, Tenor, Bass): follow your line on the score, with a tempo cursor, your voice highlighted and the others dimmed.

how.f1_p: Your part in high-contrast black, the other voices dimmed in grey.
how.f2_p: A bar follows the rhythm of your line, on rests and fermatas too.
how.f3_p: Lyrics under your voice and per-verse subtitles, synced.
how.f4_p: First listening, slow reading, at tempo, in pairs, with the choir and finally «your turn», with your voice taken out of the mix. Chapters to jump to each section.

voicesDemo: The four voices: one highlighted, the others dimmed

sources.p: We use only public-domain scores (e.g. CPDL/ChoralWiki, IMSLP, OpenScore). The source and edition of each piece are credited in that video's description.

footer.note: Public-domain scores · arrangements and attributions credited per piece.

piece.noVideo: No video has been published for this piece yet: check back soon.
piece.commonText: Traditional liturgical text, given in full: the piece may set only part of it.
piece.scoreP: The source and licence of the score are acknowledged; the editions below are for cross-checking.
piece.reportP: A wrong accidental, a misplaced note, a misspelt word: tell us where.

search.title: Search the catalogue
search.description: Search pieces, composers and lyrics in the Voce a Voce catalogue and filter by line, voice, season and genre.
search.intro: Search for a piece, a composer or a word from the text. You can narrow the results by composer, line, voice, season and genre.
search.label: Search the catalogue
search.hint: Type one or more words, or choose a filter.
search.noResults: No results. Try fewer words, check the spelling or remove a filter.
search.error: Search is not available right now. You can still browse the indexes below.
search.nojs: Search needs JavaScript. Without it, you can browse the catalogue with the indexes below.

study.title: Practice player
study.desc: Practise your part of “{title}” with the player: separate tracks per voice, scrolling score, passage looping and slower speed without changing the pitch.
study.noscript: The practice player needs JavaScript. You can still watch the videos on the piece page.
study.pickHint: When on, tap one bar for the start and another for the end of the passage; when off, a tap moves playback to that bar.
study.mixerHint: Set the volume of each voice, silence it (Mute) or hear it alone (Solo mutes all the others: for a duet, unmute one more voice).
study.myVoiceHint: Your voice at 100%, the others at 30%.
study.loopSame: “Repeat this passage” turns it on and off. If playback is outside the passage, it starts from its beginning.
study.testNotice: Test data: this page is not part of the public site.

js.errNetwork: I can't download the audio. Check your connection and try again; if it keeps failing, it may be a server error (CORS).
js.errDecode: Your browser can't decode the audio of this piece.
js.errUnsupported: Your browser doesn't support the advanced audio (Web Audio and AudioWorklet) the player needs. Try an up-to-date browser.
js.errScore: I can't show the score. The audio player may still work.
js.noStretch: Slowing down isn't available in this browser: playback is at normal speed.

loop.pickOn: Picking on the score is on: tap the first and the last bar.
loop.pickOff: Picking on the score is off: a tap moves to that bar.

study.loaderHint: On first open it can take a few seconds: we are downloading the audio of every voice.
study.optFullscreenPlay: Full screen when I press Play (phones)
study.reportScore: Report an error in the score

report.title: Report an error in the score
report.whatHint: For example: “in bar 7 the tenor has an F, it should be an F sharp”. Nothing else is needed.
report.contact: Your email (only if you want a reply)
report.privacy: We use what you write only to correct the score and, if you left your email, to reply.
report.thanks: Thank you! We have received your report.
report.short: Please write a few words about what is wrong.
report.error: We could not send it. You can write to us at {email}.
